title: AGCO Announces Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call

body_markdown:
DULUTH, Ga.


, Oct. 7, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) today announced its third-quarter 2026 earnings release conference call is scheduled for Thursday, October 29, at 10 a.m. ET. The company will refer to slides on its conference call. Interested persons can access the conference call and slide presentation via AGCO's website at[www.agcocorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789074-1&h=3005966990&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agcocorp.com%2F&a=www.agcocorp.com) under the "Investors" Section. The webcast will also be archived immediately afterward for 12 months.


**About AGCO** AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture technologies. Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands, Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™. AGCO's high-performance equipment and smart farming solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world. For more information, visit[www.agcocorp.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4789074-1&h=3005966990&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.agcocorp.com%2F&a=www.agcocorp.com) .
